BD1 independent design review
Verdict: ACCEPTED_DESIGN_ONLY
Findings: []

Reviewer: cm4_design_review_sol, independent of Root's authorship; read-only/message-only review with no authored candidate changes or sidecars.
Candidate: runs/coordination/cho51_p3_b0b1_design_20261103_v1/candidate-v1.json, 91238 bytes, SHA256 f9298285a4cce55619cd078b0628f5b681987b1d4b7ed9164aaabd6e60fd66a0.

Reviewed all eight docs/phase2/cho51_p3_b0b1_v1 files against the frozen PC1/whole-operation predecessors and current project rules. Independently checked all 491 source pins (483 inherited plus eight new), four external reference-only file pins, seven readiness source pins and local Markdown links. One owned bulk native Get-FileHash/current-size audit completed normally, exit 0: all 9783 preservation entries and all candidate source/external entries matched, zero issues across 9795 unique paths. Preservation-baseline.json is 2314458 bytes, SHA256 27e4fbe82741f5d202c7d7040bd58a6cebce9d4f254e8c868bd9eead2976f8b3. Owned scan session 14954 is closed; no interrupted or incomplete attempt is claimed as audit evidence.

The architecture separates independently adopted original H0 trust/guards/observations from candidate native G0/S0 behavior. G0 does not qualify its own guard, and B1 depends on accepted earlier capabilities. Current H0 availability, access isolation and native authority remain unestablished. Creation-before-instruction containment, explicit inheritance, distinct pending overlapped state, cancellation-through-actual-completion, first-fault/prefix retention and conservative unknown-closure treatment are retained requirements. E1 is the fixed native protocol entry, with no test child or Q/S execution. Numeric tag tables, complete effect/failure populations, closed wrapper implementations and native qualification remain implementation/admission gates, not implied by the proposed layouts. The next source-only skeleton/codecs/unavailable-H0 refusal step is appropriately bounded and does not authorize compilation or execution.

Independently checked 96/80-byte request/response sums, contiguous 80/64-byte record layouts, base64/declared escape reservations, canonical fieldwise B/I/C widths 688/684/833 including LF, original 8192-byte parser guards, 935/1024 whole and 283/320 suffix sample reservations, and conditional role equations. Source-domain stream/transport bounds do not replace global guards; finite failure/status populations, wrapper compatibility, live allocations and timing remain unproved. All 33 report reservations/owners, 18890752 report-only reserved bytes, 16 closeout roles and original guards match the predecessor. No report pooling, extra sidecar, free staging or guard bypass is admitted.

E1 supplies no CM events or terminal: I is limited to BOUND/REVOKED/DRAINED prefixes and pre-exit C remains INCOMPLETE. O and M closure remain distinct. The original post-last-write M witness must have independently established native acquisition, delivery and retention; a live host assertion or fitting encoding does not establish later file-only custody. That route explicitly remains OPEN_NOT_ESTABLISHED and blocks complete E1 acceptance. Conditional representation fit therefore does not claim end-to-end capture/closure packing, whole-operation feasibility or an available provider.

Exact prior full/Q/S/held identity arrays, all 51 module pins, all 765 held semantic rows and original debt were conserved: 1125 identities/51 modules, fixed Q360/S140, 516 baseline plus 249 new unqualified held rows, no new methods, promotions, removals or discharge. Forty distinct new BD scenarios are UNIMPLEMENTED_UNQUALIFIED; predecessor scenarios, original117/V34, continuation/custody debt and science remain unchanged.

Acceptance is design-only. File/text/JSON/hash/link/arithmetic inspection neither verifies the public API references on this device nor establishes executable syntax, native ABI/build behavior, complete effects, actual capture/custody, stop/cleanup, peak memory, timing or runtime qualification. No Python, imports, project parser/AST/compiler/native package, tests, Git or project runtime were executed. Actual entry remains REFUSED_UNADMITTED; complete capture/closure packing and whole-operation feasibility remain NOT_ESTABLISHED, P stays disabled and scientific cells remain 0/1020.
